chunks: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said, regarding the Word of God, Mighty and Majestic:
'How will it be when We bring from every community a witness, and bring you as a witness against them?'

He said: 'It was revealed specifically regarding the community of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). In every generation of them there is an Imam from us as a witness over them, and Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) is a witness over us.'

key_terms.أُمَّة: ummah — the community of believers; specifically the community of Prophet Muhammad
key_terms.إِمَام مِنَّا: Imam from us — an Imam from the Ahl al-Bayt, the family of the Prophet
key_terms.شَهِيد: shahid — divine witness; one who testifies before God on behalf of or against a community
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic — a standard honorific for God
key_terms.قَرْن: qarn — generation or century; a span of people living in a given era

ai.seo_question: What does Quran 4:41 mean according to Imam al-Sadiq — who are the witnesses from every community?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) interprets Quran 4:41 — the verse about God bringing witnesses from every community on the Day of Judgment — as referring specifically to the community of Prophet Muhammad. He explains that in every generation there is an Imam from the Ahl al-Bayt who serves as a divine witness over that generation, while the Prophet himself stands as witness over the Imams. This teaching, delivered to Sama'a, establishes the theological foundation of the Imamate as a continuous chain of divinely appointed witnesses through history.
